title: Dobrynin asks about the excitement over UFOs
summary: Harold Malmgren tells of Dobrynin asks about the excitement over UFOs, about 1960s at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Dobrynin raises UFOs with US presidential adviser

plain: Harald Malmgren, who advised US presidents, told the podcast host Jesse Michels something he says he had never spoken of before. In 1960s Washington, he says, Anatoly Dobrynin, the Soviet Union's ambassador to the United States, once asked him why everyone was so excited about unidentified flying objects, a hint that the Soviets were watching American interest in the subject.
